'''By Sun's Burning Hand''' is the Eighth Act in [[Chapter II]] of the [[Main Quests|Main Quest]].

==Summary==
<small>{{color|old|Disclaimer: This is a compilation of Skip summary and may not reflect the accuracy of story.}}</small>
{{Description|
You accept Augusta's offer and stay in Septimont City with Abby, waiting for the looming storm. A few days later, out beyond the city walls...

You're invited to the Ephor's Palace to meet Septimont's Ephor, Augusta. After an exchange of swords, she shares a brief history of Septimont's hunting traditions and formally invites you to join the hunt for the Dark Tide and its creations in the Sanguis Plateaus.

You accept and share information about the Sentinel's Relic and the Journeying Paradise. Upon hearing this, Augusta suggests that the Earthrend Wedge in the hunting grounds may be where the Relic is hidden. Before parting, she tells you that a storm rising in the skies southeast of Septimont will mark the beginning of the hunt.

Seeing a storm form in the distance, you head for Tempest Cliffs, the agreed-upon meeting point. Along the way, you encounter the Gladiator Avidius, who's also bound for the hunt. He suggests traveling together.

Under Avidius's escort, you arrive at Tempest Cliffs. Once the hunting party is assembled, Augusta gives the order to begin the campaign.

The hunting party stops at the Hunter's Den to rest and resupply. There, you meet Iuno, a Priestess of Tetragon Temple whose combat skills rival those of any Gladiator.

Augusta reveals that the beast that attacked earlier is a Corrosaurus known as "Tyrannos," one of the Dark Tide's more fearsome creations and the target of this hunt. She explains that only by slaying it within the Earthrend Wedge's range can its frequency be bound, stopping the Dark Tide's advance.

As Augusta steps away to plan the next phase of the hunt, the dreaded Whispers stir in her ears.

With time to spare, you visit Tetragon Temple and meet Avidius and Iuno. Avidius discusses the prophetic murals: The ancient Ragunnesi predicted Septimont's downfall, but the Priestesses later prophesied that a Hero of Heroes would one day rise to save it.

Avidius and Iuno clash over the prophecy. You learn that, in the Senate's eyes, Avidius better embodies the qualities of this Hero than Augusta. But Augusta pays his ambitions no mind. If anything, she welcomes any challenge from a worthy opponent.

A Griffrex's cry draws Iuno to the top of Tetragon Temple. Through the eyes of Aquila, her bonded Griffrex, she spots the Corrosaurus Tyrannos deep in Maroonwood. She launches an arrow to ignite the signal flare. The hunt is on.

At the sound of the horn, you regroup and set out for Rustblood Pass.
To lure Tyrannos into the Earthrend Wedge's range, Augusta has devised a strategy using Anchor Stones. But with traps already laid by Tyrannos, the hunting party decides it's safer to approach Maroonwood on foot.
Just before departure, Augusta hears the Whispers return with an ominous warning. The path ahead will not be easy.

The hunting party works together to activate the first Anchor Stone Obelisk. The Whispers alert Augusta to Tyrannos's surprise ambush, and she gives chase. You prepare to follow her, but Iuno arrives in time to stop you. She explains that you still have more important matters to attend to, and that it's best to leave Tyrannos to Augusta for now.

With all Anchor Stones in place, the hunting party tracks Tyrannos to Asphodel Barrens, a historical battlefield scarred by brutal conflicts between Gladiators and Dark Tide creations. Augusta, embracing her rivalry with fellow would-be Hero of Heroes Avidius, proposes they hunt the Corrosaurus together. The stakes are set for their eventual duel.

The hunting party drives the wounded Tyrannos into the lower Asphodel Barrens. Suddenly, a shrieking cry echoes across the plateau. Augusta signals Iuno just as the Dark Tide surges, swallowing Tyrannos. Iuno draws her Moon Arrow aiming at a faint humanoid figure in the distance. You realize this mysterious entity was their true target all along.

Iuno and Augusta's hunt for the humanoid is thwarted by an unknown, powerful force. The Whispers tell Augusta that to end the Dark Tide, she must return to her hometown of Murmurstown. The hunting party decides to regroup and tend to the wounded at a nearby camp.

You arrive at the camp and attend to Iuno, who's weakened from using her Forte. You ask about the strange visions she saw after firing her Moon Arrow. She's surprised you saw the Dark Tide's "illusions," but quickly realizes it's because you carry an "unknowable fate." What you witnessed, she explains, was a glimpse of the future—the fall of Septimont.

To change that fate, Iuno gave up her ability to see fate to gain a Forte capable of resisting the Dark Tide. But using this power comes at a cost. It consumes her very existence. The humanoid you saw was the Dark Tide's incarnate, the False Sovereign, and their true target all along. She and Augusta had planned to use Tyrannos as bait to lure the Sovereign out and use her power to make it vulnerable to attack, but the plan failed.

Now, to recover from the toll of using her Forte, Iuno must remain at the camp. Before parting, she entrusts you with her Lunarum bracelet, sealed with her Resonance Energy, hoping it will help you and Augusta finish the hunt in her absence.

You contact Consultant Buling of the Black Shores. She reports that the Tethys System has detected the False Sovereign rapidly consuming nearby frequencies and growing stronger. Left unchecked, it could threaten the Earthrend Wedge and trigger a catastrophic collapse. To stop the Dark Tide's spread and intercept the Sovereign, you, Augusta, and the Gladiators set out for Murmurstown, the most frequency-rich area in the hunting grounds.

Once consumed by the Dark Tide, the ruins of Murmurstown still bear its scars. In the face of such destruction, the hunting party knows this hunt cannot fail. Avidius offers to lead a team to place Anchor Stones around the town's perimeter, sealing off any escape routes. Meanwhile, you and Augusta will enter the ruins and track the Sovereign's presence.

Following a mysterious "light," you and Abby reach a group of Hollow Figures chanting a haunting "hymn." You use the power of separation to resist the Dark Tide's influence and search for the hidden "light." Your instincts tell you it's tied to the pure frequency you're after.

Elsewhere, Augusta stands before a withered oak. The Whispers tempt her to enter Oak Hollow and accept "Divinity's" power and become the prophesied Hero of Heroes. But past memories flash through her mind, and she firmly rejects the Whispers' temptation. Immediately after, she receives your signal and moves to regroup.

You bring the "light," a cloth scrap carrying the lingering frequency of a fallen Gladiator, to a Waystone. It opens a portal to a Sonoro Sphere giving off frequencies similar to the False Sovereign's. After reuniting with Augusta, you decide to enter it together.

Inside the Sonoro Sphere, you see Murmurstown as it once was before the Dark Tide, then known as Fabianum. The glowing frequency of the unyielding Gladiator's spirit appears, guiding you deeper into the Sonoro.

You find two Phantoms of the past replaying a memory. A girl named Angel scolds her friend for missing their promised trip to Manes Deep. The girl had been called to help at the blacksmith as the High Tide approached, even bearing burns from the forge trying to earn the swords needed for their trip. After all, "two lives" are needed to reach Manes Deep: one's own, and a blade. Faced with this quiet act of sacrifice, Angel is left speechless.

A second memory unfolds. A girl comforts a crying boy whose brother was gravely wounded by the Dark Tide. The boy hopes to journey to Oak Hollow to find a path to Manes Deep, believing the legendary Whispers of past Heroes of Heroes there may hold the key to healing him. The girl silently hands him her borrowed sword, giving up her own chance to enter Manes Deep without regret.

In the third memory, Angel tends to her friend's injuries sustained while standing up to a bully, causing her to miss yet another chance to visit Oak Hollow. Angel worries that the coming High Tide feels different and might make future visits to Manes Deep impossible. Still, she clings to her dream of hearing the legendary Whispers and becoming a Hero of Heroes. Her friend, however, believes a true hero is someone who brings hope to others. As the Reverberation of the past fades, you realize the quiet girl beside Angel was Augusta all along.

Augusta confirms that the Reverberations are memories from her childhood. You come to learn that the fall of Murmurstown, then called Fabianum, was not only caused by the Dark Tide, but also by corruption within Septimont's leadership. With no time to waste, you and Augusta press deeper into the Sonoro Sphere to continue the hunt for the pure Dark Tide frequency.

Deeper within the Sonoro Sphere, the guiding "light" leads you to Oak Hollow, where Phantoms replay a tragic scene. Angel lies wounded and paralyzed. Young Augusta hides her in the tree's hollow while confronting the Dark Tide alone. But the Dark Tide floods the hollow, ignoring Augusta entirely. That is the first time Augusta begins to hear the Whispers. They accuse her of weakness and deny her dream of becoming a Hero of Heroes.

Augusta opens up and confides in you about her journey to become Ephor and how her vow to protect Septimont never wavered. Augusta surprises you by saying you might be more fitting as the prophesied Hero of Heroes. You counter that a true ruler doesn't need prophecy to lead. Suddenly, you feel a shift within Oak Hollow. The pure Dark Tide frequency you've been hunting might be hiding inside.

More Phantoms appear inside Oak Hollow. Young Augusta rushes to Angel's side, believing the Whispers may have granted her the power to fend off the Dark Tide. But something is wrong. Just before her Phantom vanishes into a swirling vortex of pure Dark Tide frequency, Angel cries out, urging Augusta to flee. Stunned, you and Augusta collect the frequency and prepare to send it to Buling for analysis at the Black Shores.

Outside Murmurstown, Avidius leads the Gladiators in setting up Anchor Stones. Senator Falco criticizes his lack of leadership during the Corrosaurus hunt, claiming Avidius has failed to meet the expectations of a Hero of Heroes. After a heated argument, Falco is suddenly possessed by the Dark Tide, attacking the others.

After restoring order, Avidius sets out alone for Manes Deep to find Mesona, an herb that can help reverse the Dark Tide's corruption. But when he reaches Oak Hollow, the entrance he remembers is an impenetrable wall. Thinking it to be a Dark Tide illusion, he uses his Resonance ability to break through. The attempt fails, inadvertently awakening a sleeping power.

With the pure Dark Tide frequency you recovered, the Black Shores pinpoints the False Sovereign's location. You and Augusta head to the coordinates. Using Iuno's Lunarum bracelet, you force the Sovereign to show itself. The Gladiators, responding to Augusta's call, begin to gather for the final confrontation.

The Sovereign's power grows exponentially after absorbing the pure Dark Tide frequencies sealed within Oak Hollow and the surrounding frequencies of deceased souls in Murmurstown. It now seeks to uproot the Earthrend Wedge and unleash the full force of the Dark Tide being suppressed beneath the Sanguis Plateaus. Rinascita teeters on the brink of catastrophe.

However, Buling identifies a weakness in the Sovereign. Iuno proposes a plan to use the Anchor Stones to disrupt its internal frequency and reclaim control of the Wedge. To buy time for the plan to work, Iuno offers to put her own existence on the line by using her Forte to keep the Sovereign exposed.

As the final battle approaches, she tells you that your "unknowable fate" might be the key to overcoming the crisis. She implores that you stand with Augusta until the very end.

As you near the Earthrend Wedge, Augusta reveals that the Whispers have haunted her since the Dark Tide sixteen years ago, constantly trying to influence her choices and actions. But before you can process the revelation, she suddenly raises her sword and attacks you...

During your duel with Augusta, she finally realizes the truth behind the Whispers. The extraordinary power they promised was nothing but a trap. Breaking free from their influence, she puts her faith in you, the one with the "unknowable fate," to become the true Hero of Heroes foretold in the prophecy. As for Augusta herself, she chooses to find her own meaning in what it means to be a ruler.

Together with Augusta and the souls of fallen heroes, you defeat the False Sovereign and reclaim control over the Earthrend Wedge. The threat of the Dark Tide is finally quelled.

With the hunt officially over, you stand beside Augusta and exchange your thoughts. Before you lies the Wedge, and within it, the Relic Sentinel Imperator left for you.

You recover Imperator's Relic, but the mysterious discoid appears to be locked. To unlock its secrets and end the threat of the Dark Tide once and for all, you decide to take it to the Black Shores and Cartethyia. But first, you and Augusta choose to savor this hard-won victory.

Meanwhile, in Murmurstown, Cristoforo finds the Holmleaf Medal lost by Avidius. The Playwright's work is not yet finished...

Somewhere in Rinascita, a mysterious woman walks alongside a Dark Tide creation, her gaze fixed silently on the distant horizon. She turns to the creature and reveals the purpose of her return to this land—to hunt the Threnodian.}}

:{{A|Vo main linaxita 2 9 470 10.ogg}} '''Augusta:''' This is Septimont, a place where ideals bow to strength.
:{{A|Vo main linaxita 2 9 470 11.ogg}} '''Augusta:''' As a child, I had no desire for power. But in the City of Septimont, if I wished to rise beyond my origin and silence arrogance dressed in fame and fortune, I had no other path.

:{{A|Vo main linaxita 2 9 470 26.ogg}} '''Augusta:''' A person of immense strength is either a nemesis or a kindred spirit, both of which are intriguing to me and my blade.
:{{A|Vo main linaxita 2 9 470 27 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main linaxita 2 9 470 27 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Me? Honestly, the thought never crossed my mind.
:{{A|Vo main linaxita 2 9 470 28 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main linaxita 2 9 470 28 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' From what I've seen, being a true ruler isn't about having immense strength, whether that's a powerful Resonance ability or sheer might.
:{{A|Vo main linaxita 2 9 470 29 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main linaxita 2 9 470 29 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' I've met people from Huanglong to Rinascita who live with real integrity. Their skills and backgrounds were all different, and... none of them were perfect.
:{{A|Vo main linaxita 2 9 470 30 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main linaxita 2 9 470 30 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' But what defines them isn't strength or anything that can be measured. It's the spirit they were born with. Resilient. Unyielding. That can't be stolen.
:{{A|Vo main linaxita 2 9 470 31 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main linaxita 2 9 470 31 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Believe me, Augusta, I see that same spirit in you.
:{{A|Vo main linaxita 2 9 470 32.ogg}} '''Augusta:''' I see...
:{{A|Vo main linaxita 2 9 470 33.ogg}} '''Augusta:''' Iuno once said something similar to me.

:{{A|Vo main linaxita 2 9 470 36.ogg}} '''Augusta:''' But she failed to control it. I could do nothing but watch as she transformed into... something no longer human. After that, I never saw her again.
:{{A|Vo main linaxita 2 9 470 37 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main linaxita 2 9 470 37 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' A Dark Tide occurrence sixteen years ago... Its frequency must have been more stable than it is now.

==Glossary==
* '''Hunt''' - An operation conducted by Septimont's Gladiators to eliminate the Dark Tide and its creations within the Sanguis Plateaus.<br>The Plateaus' unique terrain allows Remnant Energy to accumulate, sustaining the lingering Blightcloud hanging over the area, a remnant of the first Dark Tide outbreak in Rinascita. Consequently, the region has become a breeding ground for Dark Tide creatures, where the Dark Tide's corruption continues to spread unchecked.<br>As the confrontation with the Dark Tide stretched on, the Septimontians discovered a strategy to effectively curb the Dark Tide's advance: luring its creations toward the Earthrend Wedge and hunting them near its base. Since then, the "hunt" gradually evolved into an institutionalized tradition deeply woven into Septimont's culture.

* '''Dark Tide Creation''' - A type of Tacet Discord born from the Dark Tide.

* '''[[Earthrend Wedge]]''' - A colossal wedge-shaped structure located in the lower levels of the Sanguis Plateaus. It descended from the high heavens alongside Rinascita's Sentinel Imperator, who had full control over it. When the first Dark Tide outbreak struck Rinascita, the Earthrend Wedge was activated. Its energy field effectively suppressed the Blightcloud above the hunting grounds, preventing it from spreading into Septimont's urban areas. Subsequently, the Dark Tide stemming from the clouds has been mostly contained within the lower levels of the Plateaus.

* '''Tempest Cliffs''' - Located on the outskirts of the city of Septimont, it's the "air terminal" where Gladiators cross the canyons and make their trip to and from the Sanguis Plateaus.

* '''[[Tetragon Temple]]''' - The living quarters of Priestesses, where fate is observed and prophecies are documented. Commonly referred to as the "Temple."

* '''[[Maroonwood]]''' - The main hunting ground on the mid to upper levels of the Sanguis Plateaus, where generations of Septimontians battled the Dark Tide and its creations.

* '''Hornett''' - A Common Echo in the form of a large horn. Hornett's high-pitched and lengthy blare is used to signal the beginning or the conclusion of large-scale hunting operations.

* '''Canyons''' - A narrow and long waterway situated between mainland Septimont and the Sanguis Plateaus

* '''Sacred Flame''' - A unique flame produced by igniting specific minerals. Its appearance resembles sunlight more than ordinary fire. The precise types and proportions of minerals used to create this flame are a closely guarded secret, passed down exclusively through generations of Priestesses.<br>While the Sacred Flame offers no special power, Priestesses channel their Resonance power through it, using its light to glimpse the future and deliver prophecies.<br>Yet to the Priestesses, the Sacred Flame is more than just a medium for divination. They view it as "celestial light descended to the mortal world," often referring to it as "the flames."

* '''Manes Deep''' - The ruins of a bygone civilization, said to be hidden deep beneath the Sanguis Plateaus. Its entrance is located in the Wastelands. Long ago, it was visited by the three Heroes of Heroes from Septimont.<br>Legend has it that those who manage to set foot in Manes Deep can hear the whispers of the Heroes of Heroes and thereby gain powers rivaling their own. Some also hold that since the Heroes of Heroes walked this place, the journey to Manes Deep has become an inescapable trial for any who would claim that title.

* '''Holmleaf Medal''' - A medal bestowed by the rulers of Septimont exclusively to Gladiators who demonstrate exceptional performance in the hunt against the Dark Tide. It is regarded as one of the highest honors among Gladiators.

* '''Griffrex''' - Native to the Septimont region, Griffrexes once coexisted with the ancestors of Septimont who sought refuge in Rinascita.<br>However, the outbreak of the first Dark Tide devastated the Border Mountains, the Griffrexes' habitat, driving most of the species to extinction. Since then, Griffrexes exist mostly as Common Echoes, which are generated at a fixed frequency from Resonance Beacons.<br>Over time, Septimontians became aware that these Griffrex Echoes still retained their instincts of hunting and sensing external frequencies. As a result, they were trained as Common Echoes for hunting purposes to track and attack Dark Tide creations.

* '''Anchor Stone''' - A type of small device manufactured with Tacetite formed around the Earthrend Wedge. It provides energy to Anchor Obelisks, which in turn amplify its frequency to repel the Dark Tide and its creations.<br>During the hunts, Gladiators of Septimont strategically set up Anchor Obelisks carrying Anchor Stones at critical locations across Maroonwood, the main battlefield. These devices help them drive the Dark Tide and its creations toward the base of the Earthrend Wedge, where they are eliminated. The strategy has proven highly effective in preventing the Dark Tide's spread beyond the Earthrend Wedge's containment.

* '''[[Asphodel Barrens]]''' - A field nestled deep within Maroonwood. At an elevation approaching Earthrend Wedge and situated in the lower middle level of the Sanguis Plateaus, it serves as the primary battleground where Gladiators engage in deadly combat with the Dark Tide and its creatures.

* '''[[Murmurstown]]''' - A lost Gladiator town located in the Wastelands at lower levels of the Sanguis Plateaus.

* '''[[The Wastelands|Wastelands]]''' - The term referring to the lower levels of the Sanguis Plateaus corrupted by the Dark Tide. This desolate region is marked by hostile conditions and is largely devoid of human activity.

* '''Mesona''' - A legendary plant said to grow in Manes Deep. It can survive for years in environments tainted by the Dark Tide, giving it a natural resistance to corruption. When used in medicine, it can slow the Dark Tide's corruption effect on the human body and help restore consciousness.

* '''Hollow Figure''' - Victims of Dark Tide corruption who have lost all self-awareness. Their bodies usually resemble stone statues while retaining their original size. Such individuals constantly murmur and recite incomprehensible words and "hymns praising the Dark Tide." The voices from the Hollow Figures have been confirmed to be mentally debilitating, capable of influencing the cognition and mental stability of ordinary people to some extent.
